description: This PHP file defines a controller class 'SaveQualificationMembershipController' responsible for handling the rendering of qualification membership pages in the OrangeHRM system. It extends an abstract Vue controller and sets up the Vue component with appropriate properties based on request attributes.

classes.name: SaveQualificationMembershipController
classes.description: Controller class for managing qualification membership data, deciding which Vue component to render based on the presence of an 'id' attribute in the request.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component to be rendered, choosing between 'qualification-membership-edit' and 'qualification-membership-save' based on the request's 'id' attribute.
